# Dmitrii Novikov — 7nolikov.dev

> Dmitrii Novikov is a distributed systems engineer based in Croatia. He
> builds and operates cloud-native data platforms (20+ microservices on the
> OSDU platform, running on Google Cloud and Kubernetes) and writes about
> distributed systems, Go, observability, and microservices in production.
> He also maintains ohmoveagain, an open-source pipeline and guide for IT
> professionals relocating to Croatia and across Eastern Europe.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://7nolikov.dev/): overview and recent writing.
- [About](https://7nolikov.dev/about/): who Dmitrii is, background, and contact/profile links.
- [Posts](https://7nolikov.dev/posts/): long-form articles on distributed systems, Go, and infrastructure.
- [Notes](https://7nolikov.dev/notes/): shorter notes and links on engineering topics.

## Projects

- [ohmoveagain](https://7nolikov.dev/ohmoveagain/): open-source, community-maintained relocation pipeline for IT professionals moving to Croatia — five stages, sourced checklists, required documents (EU Blue Card, Visa D, MUP registration), and a runway calculator. See its own llms.txt at https://7nolikov.dev/ohmoveagain/llms.txt.
